name: trigger with a quoted definer and no delimiter
sql: CREATE /* note */ DEFINER = 'u'@'localhost' TRIGGER p BEFORE INSERT ON t FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SET NEW.col=2; UPDATE t2 SET col=2; END;

name: versioned routine without delimiter
sql: /*!50003 CREATE*/ /*!50020 DEFINER=`x`@`localhost`*/ /*!50003 TRIGGER p */ BEGIN SELECT 1; UPDATE t SET col=2; END;

name: anonymous MariaDB block without delimiter
sql: BEGIN NOT ATOMIC SET @value=1; UPDATE t SET col=2; END;
